mentions.name: TrustExam
mentions.description: This platform protects the integrity of high-stakes exams and certifications — from university tests to government licensing and professional testing — and uses ethical white-hat research into how people cheat to rebuild trust in digital assessments, with a focus on scaling globally.
mentions.problem: Cheating in exams has quietly become a global industry, undermining everything from small university tests to national certifications and professional licensing.
mentions.audience: High-stakes exam and certification providers, including universities, government licensing bodies, and professional testing organizations.
mentions.source_excerpt: We’re building https://trustexam.ai that protect the integrity of high-stakes exams and certifications — from universities to government licensing and professional testing.

evidence.value: We’re building https://trustexam.ai that protect the integrity of high-stakes exams and certifications — from universities to government licensing and professional testing.
